description: A3 task 10a (F8, part 1; #733): format-only badges (owner decision 6), prescribed load and load guidance on real rows, on Round 7's owners. Badges: StructureBadge formatOnly in the shared group header (src/ui/workout-chrome.tsx); the block's prescription line under it — Review's, the timed flow's (with an EMOM's rest window) and the circuit's (BlockPanel detailLine, src/ui/block-renderers-frame.tsx, src/ui/circuit-block.tsx); SectionHeader's structure list format-only. Loads: live timed rows (TimedWorkoutFlow, the ladder's summary) read liveMovementReadings (src/ui/refinements/movement-readings.ts) through MovementIdentity. check-01 runs the five files this task owns whole (block-panel: TASK-003's carried cases on Round 7; refinement-load-guidance: TASK-036's, two restored and re-pointed at the real Review and Workout rows; amrap-block, emom-block, Workout.test.tsx: every remaining build-edited body restored, ported onto BlockSlot under PRODUCT_PRESENTATION (round-07 R7-2) or with its retired readout (R7-3)) and declares every case in them. check-02 runs the three build bodies restored in TASK-107's and TASK-108's files with the round-07 name filter (S2, S3, R7-5). parity compares /workout with the accepted cards and circuit-round states at 320 and 390. Every declared case must execute and pass.
